_about: Hand-kept half of the chunk catalog: what each training chunk is and what each experiment that isolated a chunk measured. harness/nnue/chunk_catalog.py merges this with the GPU queue's job records (which chunks each network was trained on) and the files' sizes. Add a chunk here when it is made; add an experiment when a network that differs from its base by known chunks has been measured.
